guarantees.claim: a1 is always driven with the upper 4 bits of input a (a[7:4]).
a0 is always driven with the lower 4 bits of input a (a[3:0]).
m1 is always driven with the upper 4 bits of input mask m (m[7:4]).
m0 is always driven with the lower 4 bits of input mask m (m[3:0]).
r is derived from the top 2 bits of the upper mask nibble m1 (m1[3:2]), equivalent to m[7:6].
q is always driven with the upper 4 bits of input n (n[7:4]).
s1 is also driven with the upper 4 bits of n (n[7:4]), making it identical to q.
s0 is always driven with the lower 4 bits of input n (n[3:0]).

assumptions.claim: The input mask m must be provided such that r (derived from m[7:6]) is independent of q (derived from n[7:4]).
assumptions.cond: during any use of the masked inversion
assumptions.risk: If r and q are correlated, the masking scheme may leak side‑channel information about the processed secret.

assumptions.claim: The mask m must be independent of q, i.e., n[7:4] must be uncorrelated with the whole m mask.
assumptions.cond: during any use of the masked inversion
assumptions.risk: A correlation between m and q breaks the mask independence guarantee and can expose the secret through power or timing analysis.

assumptions.claim: The input n must be the correct output mask; the chunk directly assigns s1 and s0 from n.
assumptions.risk: If n is not the intended output mask, the final unmasking will be incorrect, corrupting the AES result.

uncertain_points.claim: The independence of r and q, and of m and q, is stated but not enforced locally. Failure of the mask generation logic to satisfy these constraints would introduce side‑channel leakage.
uncertain_points.cond: when mask generation provides m and n
uncertain_points.risk: Secret information may leak if masks are not properly independent; requires verification of the mask generation module.

uncertain_points.claim: Both q and s1 are driven by the same bit‑field n[7:4]. The spec (mask paper) may define distinct roles for q and the output mask; the identity could conflict with intended separation.
uncertain_points.cond: when q and s1 are used for different masking stages
uncertain_points.risk: If q is expected to be an independent internal mask but equals the output mask upper nibble, the masking strength may be reduced.
